mgmt_bio.text: She began her Clorox career in 2003 in the Sales division, holding roles of increasing responsibility in sales planning and supply chain, and before joining Clorox she worked at Procter and Gamble in sales management. Her senior roles included president from May 2020 to September 2020, executive vice president for cleaning, international, strategy and operations, and general manager positions in the cleaning and home care businesses. She holds a bachelor's degree in economics from Harvard University and serves on the boards of Visa Inc. and the Consumer Brands Association.

citations.quote: Fiscal year 2026 was an important transition year for Clorox.
citations.title: Clorox Chair and CEO Linda Rendle on Q4 and FY26 performance

sentences.text: On May 28, 2026, Clorox announced that Chair and CEO Linda Rendle will step down for health reasons once a successor is appointed, remaining in role during a board-led search supported by an executive search firm and then advising through the transition.

Effective June 17, 2026, Chris Hyder became executive vice president and chief operating officer, while Nina Barton, formerly group president for Care and Connection, became executive vice president and chief growth and strategy officer.
Rendle described the change as evolving leadership to improve execution under the IGNITE strategy.
